title: Cultural analysis
summary: The symbolic terrain: what a street displays and what is said of it, and how description shapes who comes next.

planned.title: Display
planned.about: Shopfronts, signage, languages and register at each holding: the symbolic component of terrain (Street Oceanography §21), registered at the holding and kept apart from the physical and economic components.

planned.title: Description and its circulation
planned.about: Guides, press and visitors' accounts, read as an output of the street and a determinant of its input: the most observable segment of the circuit §16 asks a claim of co-evolution to identify.

planned.title: The record of manners
planned.about: A survey of passers-by at fixed positions, after Kon Wajirō's modernologio, as a baseline, and a protocol to repeat it on the same positions, with the conditions of its holding stated.

begins: Begins when the urban-science domain gains its culture module; its first source would be the 1925 survey's published proportions.
